$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0. Anchoring extension 0.2.0 (proposal), written against Core v1.3 rev. 11 and reference files 5.2.0, and portable verification 0.1.0. Binds only an implementation that says it uses this extension.
title: Anchoring attachment
description: Independent timestamps over exact bytes of an export, and references to the sources that keep checkpoints of its chain. The attachment sits beside the export: it never adds a field to a record or to the export. It carries references only: never a time-stamping authority's certificate or key, a witness key, or a checkpoint, since a verifier takes every source of trust from its own trust policy.

chain_id.description: The issuer's identifier of the chain the export's entries belong to. A reference: the verifier takes the chain it checks from its own configuration.

stage_id.description: A stage identifier as action binding 0.2.0 writes it.

timestamp.description: An independent timestamp: an RFC 3161 time-stamp token whose messageImprint is the SHA-256 of the exact bytes the subject names.

tsa_ref.description: A reference to the time-stamping authority. Its certificate comes from the verifier's own trust policy, never from the attachment or the token.

token_b64.description: The DER bytes of the TimeStampToken (RFC 3161 section 2.4.2: a CMS ContentInfo carrying SignedData over a TSTInfo), in padded base64.

subject.description: The exact bytes the timestamp covers, and what they are. seal: the 32 raw bytes of a record's seal_hash. chain_link: the 32 raw bytes of link(sequence) of a portable verification chain. signature: the raw bytes of a signature value: of a checkpoint of this profile, or of an assertion of the signatures profile, so that one attachment can carry the timestamps of both.

sequence.description: link(sequence): the link after the entry at this position, from 0.

of.description: The signed object whose signature value this is: a checkpoint of this profile, by its key reference, chain and count; or an assertion of the signatures profile, named as that profile names it (its assertion type, its key reference and what it names: the decision_id, and for an outcome its stage_id, or what a seal seals). profile, when given, names the signatures profile.

checkpoint_ref.description: Where checkpoints of the chain may be found. A reference only: a verifier uses a source only if its own trust policy configures it.
